He added that when RISING WORLD came back underneath him quicker than he had anticipated he was then obliged to resume riding the horse with full vigour to the end of the race.  Jockey Purton agreed with the Stewards that in the circumstances he should have continued to encourage his mount to the finish to ensure the horse’s placing was not compromised.  Noted to have lost its right hind plate after the race.  Sent for sampling post-race

When questioned L Ferraris stated that whilst he had expected to settle towards the back of the field he was asked to attempt to find the rail and take the inside runs.
